note: What a server sends to put a champion on the field. It arrives on its own and also inside EnterSight. The header carries zero or names the object this is about, and a client accepted both.

fields.name: champion
fields.note: The name the champion answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat holding it, or a negative number where no seat does.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to. A client reads it apart from the name beside it rather than as that name's leading byte.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: A client does not read it.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Nonzero for side 100, zero for side 200.

fields.name: bot
fields.note: Nonzero where a bot plays the seat; its shown name is then the client's own bot name for asset, and name is not read.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: A client does not read it.

fields.name: spawnIndex
fields.note: Where the champion first stands and faces. From 0 to 5, its side's base position plus an offset from the map's own table, chosen by the side's head count (players and bots) and this index plus one, facing as that table says; server and client must agree on the head count. From 6 up, the base position itself, facing along +X. Movement or sight data replaces it.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat holding it is called. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long it stays down, in seconds, where it is already down.

fields.name: downFor
fields.note: How long it has already been down, in seconds.

bits.name: down
bits.note: 0 alive; 1 dead but acting on (the state a champion that keeps acting after death is in), stayDown and downFor unread; 2 down, having been down for downFor with stayDown left. A client takes 3 to 7 as 0.

bits.name: swap
bits.note: Set where the champion replaces another; for the client's own seat, the client resets what it holds of its scripts once the champion is made. Of no effect otherwise.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

revisions.note: The champion takes the id in champion, not the header's; a client first removes any object holding that id. For the client's own seat, name also becomes its own player's name. A client drops the message while its map's navigation data is not yet loaded, as early in a reconnection.

fields.name: champion
fields.note: The name the champion answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat holding it, or a negative number where no seat does.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to. A client reads it apart from the name beside it rather than as that name's leading byte.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: What level the champion's own spells stand at.

bits.name: side
bits.note: Which of the two sides the champion is on. Set in everything observed.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: How well it plays where nobody holds it.

fields.name: spawnIndex
fields.note: Which of its side's starting places the champion begins at, counted from zero. Where a champion first stands travels in EnterSight. Captured traffic carries values from 0 to 3 here, and also carries 0 for every champion while the places they stand at differ, so where a champion starts is not settled by this field alone.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat holding it is called. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long it stays down, in seconds, where it is already down.

fields.name: downFor
fields.note: How long it has already been down, in seconds.

fields.name: deathKind
fields.note: What sort of death it is already in, where it is already down.
